stories.title: CVS puts one system behind nearly 3,000 store-brand packs
stories.blurb: Pearlfisher redesigned the CVS store brand, starting with 68 pain-relief products in June 2025. The wordmark drops "Health" and keeps the heart. The article's point is the system that holds nearly 3,000 products across more than 20 categories together.

sources.name: PRINT
sources.headline: CVS and Pearlfisher Make the Case for Systems Design

stories.title: Trustpilot gets a new identity from Further
stories.blurb: London agency Further has overhauled Trustpilot's visual system. The article itself was not accessible, so this summary rests on the announcement lead.

sources.name: Design Week
sources.headline: Trustpilot reveals new brand identity by Further

stories.title: AI firms agree on one opt-out standard for publishers
stories.blurb: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic say they will adopt one standard. Publishers can set their AI training preferences once and apply them across several crawlers.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping

stories.title: Google admits AI search earns less, and plans more ads
stories.blurb: Google says AI search makes less money than classic search and will make up for it with more ads. Negative cash flow widened to minus 9.06 billion dollars, and the stock fell after the Q3 results.

sources.name: Ars Technica
sources.headline: Google admits AI search makes less money, but it's fixing that with more ads
